Definition: Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jarmuth is the name of two towns in the land, one in the low country of Judah whose king joined the league against Gibeon, and one in Issachar where families settled after the return. The king of Jarmuth fell with the five kings, and the town lived on in the days of Nehemiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the towns of the enemy can become the homes of God's people, and Jarmuth outlived its king.
